title: Implement Request Body Parsing Support
description: Adding request body parsing support will enable yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded requests, making it a more versatile and user-friendly framework. This feature will allow developers to easily access and manipulate request data. By including this feature, yantraverse will be more competitive with other Node.js frameworks
acceptance: Request body is correctly parsed and accessible in the request object
reason: Business justification: improves user experience and competitiveness, Technical justification: enhances framework functionality and versatility
